topic: Where to store your 72-hour supplies in a small apartment

content.hook: Where would 72 hours of supplies fit?

scenes.text: Where would *72 hours* of supplies fit?
Use dead space: *under the bed*, top of the wardrobe, behind the sofa
Water is the bulky part. Store it *low*, cool and dark.
A calm plan that *fits your flat*

content.caption:
Where to store 72-hour supplies in a small apartment? You don't need a pantry. You need a few smart spots.

Try this:
• Use dead space: under the bed, on top of the wardrobe, behind the sofa.
• Keep water low, cool and out of direct sun. It's the heaviest part.
• Split supplies between two or three places, so one closed door doesn't block everything.
• Keep your grab-and-go bag near the front door.
• Note the spots on one list, so everyone at home knows.

Ready72h is based on official guidance from MSB, BBK and RCB. The apartment edition covers storing supplies in a small space.
